parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the Prometheus instance.

parameters.name: MonitoringName
parameters.description: The name of the monitoring configuration.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the monitoring configuration. 
Valid values for a Prometheus instance for Container Service: serviceMonitor, podMonitor, customJob, and probe. 
Valid values for a Prometheus instance for ECS: customJob and probe.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms delete-prometheus-monitoring --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --type probe --monitoring-name customJob1 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms DeletePrometheusMonitoring --region cn-hangzhou --Type probe --ClusterId cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --MonitoringName customJob1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
